title: Distributional RL: C51 and quantile losses

chapters.text: Start with one atom. Transported location: 2; Total probability: 1; Projected mean: 2.
Move its target location. Transported location: 1.82; Total probability: 1; Projected mean: 1.82.
Find neighboring atoms. Transported location: 1.65; Total probability: 1; Projected mean: 1.65.
Split probability mass. Transported location: 1.48; Total probability: 1; Projected mean: 1.48.
Check mass and mean. Transported location: 1.3; Total probability: 1; Projected mean: 1.3.
